reasoning: The icon depicts a straight upward arrow with a second arrow branching off to the right, standard on road signs (straight or right) and for branching/forking. In a task list it fits git branching/forking tasks, route detours, trail junctions, and workflow splits, though it is somewhat abstract outside software and navigation.
